author: Wrenchwise
scope: Original, provisional Lexus LS generation studies. Not approved repair replicas.

sources.title: 1998 LS400 stock-car walkaround — Bring a Trailer
sources.scope: Actual 44-second walkaround reviewed at 0:00, 0:23 and 0:33. Shared facelift body contour, outer tail-lamp taper and fuel flap only. US LHD car with five-opening wheels; not evidence for UK wheel choice or engine-bay installation. No surveyed measurements.

sources.title: Lexus 1990 UK LS400 G227 XPK — front three-quarter photograph
sources.scope: Pre-facelift grille lattice, three-section lamp outline, amber bumper indicators, rectangular fog lamps, rounded bumper ends, side-glass silhouette and 15-opening wheel faces. Visual reference only; image is not used as a model texture.

sources.title: Lexus 1990 UK LS400 G227 XPK — rear three-quarter photograph
sources.scope: Rounded C-pillar, rear screen, boot deck, wraparound red/amber lamps with inner reverse lenses, bumper and dual exhaust. Shapes inferred from perspective photographs.

sources.title: Anglia Car Auctions — photographed UK 1990 LS400 engine bay
sources.scope: RHD configuration: brake booster at rear vehicle-right; side-entry intake and ribbed plenum; oil cap near front vehicle-right; coolant tank, fuse box, battery and washer filler on vehicle-left. Individual part dimensions and hidden routes are unmeasured. Listing: https://angliacarauctions.co.uk/auctions/2718-30-Aug-2025/11160~2-1990-lexus-ls400-auto

sources.title: 1990 LS400 owner/seller engine-bay photography
sources.scope: Photo of a US LHD vehicle: central V8 and intake, side air cleaner, forward battery and radiator air guide. Used only for shared visual layout; it does not establish the UK RHD brake installation or original replacement parts.

sources.title: Lexus UK 1990 LS400 launch specifications
sources.scope: Length, width excluding mirrors, height, wheelbase, track, overhangs and 1UZ-FE architecture.

sources.title: Lexus first-generation exterior archive
sources.scope: Body proportions, rectangular lamps, grille, two-tone lower trim and window outline. Multi-year gallery; individual trim details remain provisional.

sources.title: Lexus UK revised second-generation launch specifications
sources.scope: 1998 revision: nominal envelope, 2850 mm wheelbase, 1UZ-FE with VVT-i and five-speed automatic.

sources.title: Lexus 1998–2000 exterior archive
sources.scope: Revised headlamp outline, bonnet, side profile and rear silhouette.

sources.title: Lexus facelift LS400 LEX 401 — front three-quarter photograph
sources.scope: 1998–2000 UK facelift: clear headlamp reflectors with integrated amber corners, trapezoidal horizontal grille, bumper fog lamps, rounded side glass and seven-opening 16-inch wheels. Photo-informed shapes; no image textures used.

sources.title: Lexus facelift LS400 LEX 401 — rear three-quarter photograph
sources.scope: Facelift boot deck, C-pillar, red/amber rear combination lamps, inset reverse lenses and bumper curvature.

sources.title: Car & Classic — photographed 1998 UK RHD LS400 VVT-i engine bay
sources.scope: Photographed bay: large removable black cover around a ribbed central plenum, front intake duct, vehicle-right coolant and power-steering reservoirs, vehicle-left battery and fuse box, and moulded front air guide. Local dimensions and hidden routes remain estimates; replacement parts may differ. Bay photo: https://assets.carandclassic.com/uploads/new/16203817/0361fd56-35d8-48f8-8e0e-4295bc16b711.jpg

sources.title: Lexus early LS430 exterior archive
sources.scope: Taller cabin, larger lamps, roof and side-glass outline; pre-facelift.

sources.title: Lexus Canada 2007 LS460 specifications
sources.scope: Standard wheelbase, RWD: 5030 × 1875 × 1475 mm, 2969 mm wheelbase, 18-inch wheels; not LS460L, AWD or LS600h.

sources.title: Lexus 2007–2010 LS460 exterior archive
sources.scope: Launch-era grille, swept lamps, shoulder and roof silhouette. UK photos used only as visual references for shared body shape.

sources.title: Lexus LS460 engine archive
sources.scope: Engine cover and longitudinal V8 visual arrangement; no dimensional survey.
